momentum_signal: adjusted month-end level m-1 / m-12 - 1; 11 months skipping latest month
risk_adjusted_momentum: same momentum divided by daily sample volatility over same window
stock_history_limit: Current constituents with complete history; survivor-biased. These dates were already reviewed. Exploratory only.
funds_are_separate_implementations: Fund results do not validate our custom stock rule. Fund adjusted returns include fund expenses; wrapper trading fees are additional.
selection_metric: maximum of worst annual arithmetic mean advantage versusSPY andQQQ after all development net paths normalized to one common realized volatility
exact_volatility_comparison: For each evaluation group q=min(all realized volatilities); scale each net-return path by q/sigma<=1. Statistical normalization only, not an executable cash sleeve.
primary_research_pipelines: raw holdings plus common causal10pct volatility overlay; select based on overlay pipeline development results; report both
locked_evaluation: Choose one stock rule and one published-fund rule on their development periods. Freeze before inspecting final results. Retain every candidate result and all tested variants.

uncertainty.simultaneous_comparisons: all candidates in each prespecified risk-controlled pipeline versus both benchmarks
uncertainty.primary_inference_pipeline: risk_controlled; raw paths and cost sensitivity are descriptive

claim_limit: Historical results are not proof of future outperformance. Prior research, universe limitations, factor choice and fund survival remain outside statistical correction.
